original_content_full:
The paper "Semantic-driven Visualization Techniques for Interactive Exploration of 3D Indoor Models" by Alessandro Florio, Matthias Trapp, and Jürgen Döllner has been accepted as a contribution to the 23rd International Conference Information Visualisation (IV 2019). The conference will be held in Paris, France from the 2nd to 5th of July.
